user.title: TEO Setup — Language
user.description: Select a language. If you have a previous installation ID you can enter it to restore your setup (optional).

zone.title: Grid area
zone.description: Your grid area determines which Nord Pool prices TEO uses.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: TEO Local runs 100% offline with no account. TEO Self-Hosted connects to the TEO API with a free account (enter email).

discovery.title: Devices found on your network
discovery.description: Select the devices TEO should control. Devices not found can be added later.

parameters.title: System parameters
parameters.description: All values have sensible defaults and can be changed later.

data.charge_from_grid_below_ore: Charge battery from grid if price below (øre/kWh)

error.invalid_id: The installation ID is not in a valid format.
error.id_not_found: ID not found — starting a new installation.

abort.already_configured: TEO is already configured for this installation.

step1.title: Select language
step1.description: You can change the language again in settings.

step2.title: Select grid area
step2.description: Your grid area determines which Nord Pool prices TEO uses.

step3.title: Find your devices
step3.description: TEO scans your network for known devices. This typically takes 30 seconds.

step4.title: System parameters
step4.description: All values have sensible defaults. You can change them later.
step4.min_soc_description: TEO will never discharge the battery below this level.
step4.ev_protection_description: The EV charger is paused if battery drops below this level.
step4.charge_below_label: Charge battery from grid if price below
step4.charge_below_description: TEO charges the battery from the grid when the spot price is below this threshold.
step4.use_battery_above_description: TEO uses the battery instead of the grid when the price exceeds this threshold.
step4.solcast_key_description: Free key from solcast.com. Requires registration.
step4.tilt_description: Angle from horizontal. Flat roofs = 10°, pitched roofs = 30–45°.
step4.degradation_cost_description: TEO includes battery wear in its calculations. The default of 0.04 DKK/kWh corresponds to approximately 0.5% of battery replacement cost per full cycle.

step5.title: Ready to install
step5.description: TEO will now install only the integrations you need.

reasoning.battery_charge_grid: Current price {price} øre/kWh. Forecast shows {future_price} øre/kWh {timerange}. Expected net gain: {net} DKK after battery wear cost of {degradation} DKK.
reasoning.battery_charge_solar: Battery charging from surplus solar production ({solar} kWh available). Free energy stored for later use.
reasoning.battery_discharge: Current price {price} øre/kWh exceeds your threshold of {threshold} øre/kWh. The battery ({soc}%) is used instead of expensive grid power.
reasoning.battery_idle: Price {price} øre/kWh is in the normal range. Battery kept in standby; the inverter manages self-consumption.
reasoning.ev_pause_soc: Battery dropped to {soc}% — below your threshold of {threshold}%. EV charging stopped to protect the battery. Resumes automatically when SOC is above {resume}%.
reasoning.ev_pause_price: Current price {price} øre/kWh is high. EV charging deferred to cheaper hours ({timerange}).
reasoning.ev_allowed: Battery at {soc}% is above the protection threshold of {threshold}%. EV charging allowed at full current.
reasoning.no_grid_charge_solar: Solcast forecasts {kwh} kWh of solar tomorrow. The battery at {soc}% will be fully charged by {time}. Grid charging unnecessary.
reasoning.optimisation_recalculated: Nord Pool published tomorrow's prices. Cheapest {n} hours: {cheap_times} (avg {cheap_avg} øre/kWh). Most expensive {n} hours: {expensive_times} (avg {expensive_avg} øre/kWh). Plan updated.

errors.nordpool_unavailable: Nord Pool prices unavailable — using fallback plan
errors.solcast_unavailable: Solcast forecast unavailable — using historical average
